agent_explanation: No walls, no controller (work=0). With large dt=0.02138 and high speed (~57 m/s), semi-implicit Euler substepped ~41-43 times per step still integrates free-fall inaccurately, causing monotonic energy growth about +174 J over 4 steps, exceeding 10%+5J tolerance. Reducing dt to 0.001 removes the error, proving numerical integration error, not external work.
